hook: Hardik Pandya: 2,955 IPL runs and 82 wickets. Is there anyone like him?
lines: Only Watson, Jadeja and Russell have also passed 2,500 runs and 75 wickets.
Over his whole career, his closest statistical twin is Marcus Stoinis, 16 points away.
In the IPL he bowls 15 balls a game, in the powerplay, the middle overs and at the death.
For India, he adds wins with the bat and with the ball.
His best IPL years were 2017 to 2019. Since 2023, the numbers have dipped.
